nodes.description: Public string holding the token URI extension '.json' used in tokenURI.
Public mint price per token, set to 0.00 ether.
Public hard cap on the number of mintable tokens (7800).
Public maximum number of tokens mintable in a single transaction (20).
Public boolean that pauses minting when true.
Public base URI prefixed to every token URI.
Counter from WithLimitedSupply tracking how many tokens have been minted.
Maximum supply stored in WithLimitedSupply.
Initial token ID offset stored in RandomlyAssigned.
Mapping used by RandomlyAssigned for random index assignment of token IDs.
Public payable mint function; validates amount, payment and supply, then loops calling nextToken and _safeMint.
Internal RandomlyAssigned.nextToken that derives a pseudo-random token ID from block variables and the tokenMatrix.
Owner-only withdraw that sends the entire contract balance to msg.sender via send.
Public view returning baseURI concatenated with the token ID and baseExtension.
Public view returning the array of token IDs owned by an address.
Internal override returning the baseURI state variable.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, owner check, withdraw recipient and randomness seed.
Miner-influenceable value included in the pseudo-random seed of nextToken.
Pseudo-random number generation via keccak256 of msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit and block.timestamp.
Low-level send of the whole contract balance inside withdraw, an external call to msg.sender.
_safeMint external call to onERC721Received on the recipient, enabling callback reentrancy into mint.
Caller-supplied number of tokens to mint in mint().
Address parameter of walletOfOwner used for enumeration queries.
Token ID parameter of tokenURI used for existence check and URI building.
Local variable in mint() storing the token ID returned by nextToken().
Loop counter in mint() iterating from 1 to _mintAmount.
Arithmetic in mint(): totalSupply() + _mintAmount and cost * _mintAmount.

edges.reason: msg.sender is mixed into the keccak256 randomness seed, letting the caller partially influence the generated token ID.
block.timestamp is part of the pseudo-random seed, enabling miner/caller timestamp manipulation of the token ID.
nextToken() derives the token ID from predictable block variables rather than a secure randomness source.
_mintAmount drives the mint loop bounds and the supply/payment validations.
_mintAmount is multiplied by cost and added to totalSupply() in mint().
Loop counter i iterates the mint loop _mintAmount times.
mint() calls nextToken() to obtain a random token ID for each iteration.
mintIndex stores the value returned by nextToken() inside the loop.
mintIndex is passed into _safeMint, which triggers the onERC721Received callback on the recipient.
_safeMint performs an external callback before the mint loop finishes, allowing reentrancy into mint().
_msgSender() is used as the recipient of _safeMint inside mint().
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with msg.sender.
require(_mintAmount <= maxMintAmount) bounds the per-transaction mint amount.
require(totalSupply() + _mintAmount <= maxXIA) enforces the global supply cap.
require(!paused) gates execution of mint().
msg.value >= cost * _mintAmount enforces the payment requirement.
withdraw forwards the entire contract balance through a low-level send to msg.sender.
The recipient of the withdraw send is the owner-controlled msg.sender.
The external send occurs before the return-value requirement is checked in withdraw.
baseURI is read to construct the returned token URI.
tokenId is used for the existence check and concatenated into the token URI.
_owner address is used to query balance and enumerate owned tokens.
_baseURI() returns baseURI which is consumed by tokenURI.
_tokenCount is read via tokenCount() to compute maxIndex in nextToken().
maxSupply() derived from _maxSupply is used to compute the random index bound.
tokenMatrix is read and written during random index assignment in nextToken().
startFrom is added to the selected index before returning the token ID.

normalization_plan.reason: The _mintAmount parameter has no standalone meaning and is only used inside the mint function for validation and loop control.
The _owner parameter is only consumed by walletOfOwner for enumeration queries.
The tokenId parameter is only used inside tokenURI for existence checking and URI construction.
The mintIndex local variable is a transient result of nextToken() used only within the mint loop.
The i local variable is only the loop counter of the mint function and carries no independent semantics.
